303202.nameEn: Hanging by a Thread, Yet Full of Zest

ranks.1:
[Hot Sauce Expert]'s Insight I gains a new effect:
Moxie is replaced by Thread Points; self skills that gain benefits based on Moxie are changed to gain benefits based on Thread Points instead. The Ultimate no longer counts toward the Spelldock Draw Limit.
At the start of the round, generates 1 [Thread: Heaven's Fortune] at a random position other than self's own position (up to 4 Threads may exist at each position).
[Victorious General] gains a new effect: Shifts self 1 position forward after casting.
[Outdoor Superstar] gains a new effect: Shifts self 1 position backward after casting.
ranks.2:
[Victorious General]'s effect is enhanced: Deals additional Reality DMG equal to 100% of the base Reality DMG.
[Outdoor Superstar]'s effect is enhanced: Deals additional Reality DMG equal to 100% of the base Reality DMG.
ranks.3: [Reality Show Premiere] gains a new effect: Deals additional Reality DMG equal to (self Thread Points x400% of the base Reality DMG).
ranks.4:
[Hot Sauce Expert]'s Insight III gains a new effect: When entering battle, self Thread Points +3.
[Reality Show Premiere] gains a new effect: If holding 4/5/6 Thread Points when cast, grants all allied characters 1/2/3 stack(s) of [Fortune].

ranks.1: [The Proud Star]'s Insight I gains a new effect: Whenever an enemy is inflicted with [Burn] or [Halo], accumulates [Lingering Glow]; before attacking, Matilda inflicts 3 stacks of [Halo] on the target.
ranks.2:
[The Proud Star]'s Insight III gains a new effect: If Beryl is present in the team, after Beryl actively casts [Blaze Through the Lens], Matilda additionally casts a rank 1 [Work of Genius].
[Work of Genius]'s effect is enhanced: Deals additional Mental DMG equal to 200% of the base Mental DMG; if the target's [Halo] reaches 5/10/20/30 stacks, increases all allies' Critical Rate by 25%/50%/75%/100% for 3 rounds.
ranks.3:
[The Proud Star]'s Insight III gains a new effect: If Beryl is present in the team, after Beryl actively casts [Nothing Unexpected], Matilda additionally casts a rank 1 [Attention Everyone].
[Attention Everyone]'s effect is enhanced: Deals additional Mental DMG equal to 200% of the base Mental DMG; if the primary target's [Halo] reaches 5/10/20/30 stacks, increases self ATK by 15%/25%/50%/80% for 3 rounds.
ranks.4:
[The Proud Star]'s Insight III gains a new effect: If Beryl is present in the team, after Beryl actively casts [A Shimmering Night], Matilda additionally casts [Instant of Prediction].
[Instant of Prediction]'s effect is enhanced: Deals additional Mental DMG equal to 200% of the base Mental DMG; after attacking, inflicts [Deflection] on the target for 3 rounds.

ranks.1:
[Calculation of Genesis] gains a new effect: Self gains the Perception Skill Set [Reductio ad Absurdum]; when entering battle, gains [Eye of Perception] and fills 2 [Star Perception Points];
[Supplementary Formula] gains a new effect: Fills 1 [Star Perception Point] (triggers at most once per round).
ranks.2: [Calculation of Genesis]'s condition for gaining Eureka changes from "after self casts an Incantation / after another ally takes an extra action" to "after any ally acts."
ranks.4:
[Numeral Perception] is no longer a stackable buff; it becomes an ATK increase equal to 20% of 37's ATK, capped at 500.
[Kingdom of Geometry]'s [Numeral Perception] granted to all allies becomes 2 rounds; gains a new effect: self gains [Continuous Action I] for 2 rounds.
[Calculation of Genesis], when entering battle, changes its Critical Rate increase to affect all allies, with an additional Critical Rate increase equal to 50% of the base value, and gains a new effect: self Moxie +3, self Eureka cap +5, and all allied [Perception] characters' Ultimates no longer count toward the Spelldock Draw Limit.

portraits.p1:
[Calculation of Genesis]: When entering battle, the Critical Rate increase for all allies is increased to 60%; the Moxie gained is increased to 5.
[Kingdom of Geometry]: [Numeral Perception]'s duration is increased to 3 rounds; [Continuous Action I]'s duration is increased to 3 rounds.
portraits.p2:
[Calculation of Genesis]: [Supplementary Formula]'s Mental DMG dealt is increased to 450%; the additional Genesis DMG is increased to (self ATK x150%).
[Calculation of Genesis]'s Perception Skill Set [Reductio ad Absurdum] is enhanced:
[Perception Ability-1]: During [Full Pursuit], the decrease to all enemies' Perception DMG Taken Reduction becomes 70%, and the decrease to their overall DMG Taken Reduction becomes 70%;
[Perception Incantation]'s Mental DMG dealt is increased to 900%; [Dichotomy Paradox]'s coefficient is increased to 60%.
portraits.p3:
[Kingdom of Geometry]: [Enlightenment] granted is increased to 3 stacks; the Eureka self gains is increased to 3; [Numeral Perception]'s ATK increase is increased to 24% of 37's ATK, with the cap increased to 600.
[Triangulation]: At Incantation rank 1/2/3, the Mental DMG dealt is increased to 300%/450%/750%, and the additional Genesis DMG is increased to 100%/150%/250%.
[Curve Mapping]: At Incantation rank 1/2/3, the Mental DMG dealt is increased to 160%/240%/400%, the additional Genesis DMG is increased to 100%/150%/250%, and it additionally grants 1 stack of [Sturdiness].
portraits.p4:
[Calculation of Genesis]: [Supplementary Formula]'s Mental DMG dealt is increased to 600%; the additional Genesis DMG is increased to (self ATK x200%).
[Triangulation], [Kingdom of Geometry]: [Enlightenment]'s effect of increasing Incantations' additional Genesis DMG is increased to 200%.
portraits.p5:
[Kingdom of Geometry]: The Eureka self gains is increased to 4.
[Calculation of Genesis]'s Perception Skill Set [Reductio ad Absurdum] is enhanced:
[Perception Ability-1]: During [Full Pursuit], the decrease to all enemies' Perception DMG Taken Reduction becomes 100%, and the decrease to their overall DMG Taken Reduction becomes 100%;
[Perception Incantation]'s Mental DMG dealt is increased to 1000%; [Dichotomy Paradox]'s coefficient is increased to 80%.

ranks.1: [Genius Idea] no longer gives the Ultimate a chance to be recast; changed to: at the start of each round, if self's Moxie reaches 5 and [Genius Idea] reaches the original Ultimate's consumption stack count, consumes that stack count and gains 1 stack of [Endless Inspiration] (triggers at most once per round); for every 1 stack of [Genius Idea] self holds, has the original base chance to gain 1 additional stack of [Endless Inspiration], up to a maximum of 4 stacks; if [Endless Inspiration] has reached its stack limit, [Genius Idea] is no longer consumed
ranks.2: [Miniature Set] new effect: Moxie +3 for self when entering battle; when another ally casts an Ultimate, Noire gains 1 stack of [Scene Direction], up to a stack limit equal to the original stack limit of [Genius Idea]
ranks.3:
[Climactic Moment] no longer consumes AP, and deals additional Mental DMG equal to 100% of the base Mental DMG;
[Climactic Moment]'s Penetration Rate increase per 1 stack of [Neg Status] held by the target is changed to: Penetration Rate is increased per 1 type of [Neg Status] held, and the maximum Mental DMG increase based on the number of types of [Neg Status] held by the target is increased to 100% of the original base

312101.nameEn: Blessings That Stay the Whole Journey Through

ranks.1:
[To the "Family"] effect enhanced:
If at no less than 10 stacks of [Readiness], all allies gain [Assertiveness] for 1 round
ranks.3:
[Astray No More] effect enhanced: deals additional Reality DMG equal to 100% of the base Reality DMG; both active and riposte casts deal additional DMG and grant additional [Ceremonious: Critical DMG]
[The Past Shattered] effect enhanced: if self is in [Continuous Action I] status before attacking, deals additional Reality DMG equal to 100% of the base Reality DMG; after attacking, inflicts 2 stacks of [Passion Drain] on the target
ranks.4:
[The Future Reclaimed] effect modified:
Gains [Lightning Trigger] for 2 rounds
[Lightning Trigger] effect modified:
When an ally is attacked, Moldir counters with the corresponding rank of [The Past Shattered] (triggers once per round); at the start of the round, if not in [Doctrine] status, gains [Total Onslaught] for 1 round

ranks.1: [Nothing Unexpected]'s [Vision] stacks granted are additionally increased by 100% of the original base amount, and grants [Foresight] for 2 rounds.
ranks.2:
[Clairvoyant Prism] gains new effects:
[Emanation of Blue]: Consumes 3 stacks of [Vision]; when [Destined Doom] is cast this round, deals additional Mental DMG equal to 35% of the original base Mental DMG, up to 1/2/3 times at Incantation rank 1/2/3; and at the end of the round, self Moxie +1.
[Emanation of Purple]: Extends [Foresight]'s duration by 1/1/2 round(s); consumes 3 stacks of [Vision]; when [Destined Doom] is cast this round, for every point of [Lingering Glow], deals additional Mental DMG equal to 100% of the original additional Mental DMG per point of [Lingering Glow], up to 1/2/3 times at Incantation rank 1/2/3, and at the end of the round, self Moxie +1.
[Emanation of Green]: Consumes 3 stacks of [Vision]; when [Destined Doom] is cast this round at rank 1/2/3, deals additional Mental DMG equal to 150% of the original additional Mental DMG at rank 1/2/3, up to 1/2/3 times at Incantation rank 1/2/3, and at the end of the round, self Moxie +1.
ranks.3:
[A Shimmering Night]'s Mental DMG dealt is increased, equal to 100% of the base Mental DMG, and gains a new effect: this attack is affected by 100% Incantation Might; when attacking, for every point of [Lingering Glow], deals an additional 2% Mental DMG; after attacking, self gains 10 stacks of [Vision].
[Prism Mirror] gains a new effect: When entering battle, self gains 10 stacks of [Vision].
ranks.4: [Destined Doom]'s Mental DMG dealt is increased, equal to 20% of the base Mental DMG; for every stack of [Vision] held, this attack's ATK is increased by 0.2%, counting up to 20 stacks.
